### Which file do I need?

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Tiddlui_*_x64-setup.exe` — the installer (an `.msi` is also attached) |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Tiddlui_*_amd64.deb` |
| Any other Linux | `Tiddlui_*.AppImage` — self-contained, which is why it's much larger |

Arch Linux: an AUR package is planned — see the README.

On Linux, install `ffmpeg` from your package manager. Windows fetches it on first launch.
